name: Nagatoro (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nagatoro town emblem in white: a stylised letter G with an angular bar.
history: Municipal flag of Nagatoro, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1972.

features.role: Nagatoro town emblem — a stylised letter G with an angular bar
